verdict.rationale: Mercury documents a broad public REST API covering accounts, transactions, payments and transfers, cards, invoices, customers and webhooks. It supports scoped read-only, read-write and custom tokens plus OAuth2, and has an interactive API reference with a Try It runner and code samples. A sandbox, a versioned /api/v1/ base path, a public changelog with migration guides, an official Go SDK, and llms.txt markdown docs for agents round it out. A community user praises the quality of Mercury's exposed software surface, though that is light corroboration. Missing for 10: a publicly downloadable OpenAPI spec (probes show it is admin-only), a written deprecation/sunset policy, official SDKs beyond Go, and stronger independent hands-on corroboration of API use.
